title: Checklist coverage report v1
description: The `--output` of `eval score checklist`: required-point coverage of each arm against the questions' expected_topics, judged by a model, with each arm compared to the baseline. `judge_temperature` is added by the command.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

judge_temperature.description: The sampling temperature the judge ran at; added by the command.

summary.description: Coverage per arm and the comparison to the baseline arm.

questions.description: One entry per question: `question_id`, `question_text`, and `arms` (coverage and the judged points of each arm).
